Hi Alicia,

I noticed Neurolytics crossed the 250k token threshold yesterday — congrats on the ramp! I work with the team that helps self-serve customers translate usage into reliable performance and predictable costs. Would you be open to a quick 15–20 minute walkthrough so we can:

- Review the spike and common causes (batching / prompt patterns)
- Show a few immediate levers (KV caching, small quantization tradeoffs)
- Share a short agenda and next steps for a tech check if needed

I have these slots (PDT):
- Thu 09/05, 9:30–9:50am
- Thu 09/05, 11:00–11:20am
- Fri 09/06, 1:00–1:20pm

If none of those work, drop a couple times that do and I’ll loop in our engineer. Here’s a one-click calendar link if you prefer to pick: https://calendly.com/redwood-dylan/20m

Attached is a 1-page agenda I use for these quick syncs.

Best,
Dylan Brooks
SDR, Redwood Inference
dylan_brooks@redwood.inference

- Any quick recommendations around request batching versus latency tradeoffs

I’m on PDT and the morning slots tomorrow are tricky. Can we do Fri 09/06 at 1pm PDT instead?

Also, I’ll include our engineering manager (cc’d on follow-ups) if we decide to do a technical deep-dive.

— Alicia
